source_name: Payten Montenegro (Asseco/ASEE group) - corporate site & news/case-study feed
source_subtype: vendor corporate site / news & case studies
why_relevant: Payten is the dominant ATM/POS solutions and servicing company in Montenegro (present since 2006, ~28 staff, six service centres, >500 ATMs and >13,000 POS terminals delivered, partnerships with 9 of ME's 11 banks). Its news section publishes named bank case studies (e.g. SoftPOS at Hipotekarna banka), which directly reveal which ME bank bought which payment product.

source_name: MoneyGet Crna Gora (Payten/Asseco independent ATM network in ME)
why_relevant: MoneyGet is the Asseco/Payten-operated independent ATM network in Montenegro. Its site exposes ATM footprint, partner banks and acceptance arrangements - a direct read on who operates off-bank cash infrastructure in ME and which banks partner into it.

source_name: e-mon servisni centar (ASEE Montenegro e-banking service centre)
source_subtype: vendor service-centre site / de-facto reference list
why_relevant: e-mon is the ASEE-run e-banking service centre operating in Montenegro since 2004. Its homepage is effectively a published client reference list naming nine ME banks (CKB, NLB, Erste, Prva banka Crne Gore, Universal Capital Bank, Ziraat, Lovcen banka, Addiko, Adriatic Bank) and the exact products they run (OfficeBanking Desktop/Enterprise, web/mobile banking, SMS/e-mail notifications). One of the highest-density vendor-to-bank mapping pages found for ME.

source_name: Asseco SEE / ASEE Podgorica office and solutions portfolio
why_relevant: ASEE has a registered Podgorica office (Serdara Jola Piletica 3A) and is the umbrella for both Payten and e-mon in ME. Group site carries the solution portfolio (core banking adjacent, cards, ATM/EFTPOS supply and installation) and periodic contract announcements relevant to ME banks.

source_name: Logate d.o.o. (Podgorica) - case studies and banking products
source_subtype: software house corporate site / case-study library
why_relevant: Montenegro-headquartered (2006) software house that implements and maintains systems for banks in ME and Europe. Products CX360 (banking CRM) and Connect (omnichannel contact centre); published/reported bank clients include Nasa AIK Banka, Erste, NLB and CKB. Dedicated /case-studies/ and /partners/ pages are exactly the reference-page pointer this cell targets.

source_name: 2BI d.o.o. Podgorica - IT integrator and CBCG-licensed digital payment institution
why_relevant: Rare hybrid: a Montenegrin IT integrator that is itself a CBCG-licensed payment institution providing PSD2 AIS/PISP services, plus the 'Digitalni Kiosk' consumer payment app. Site carries a client section with a CKB Banka IT Operations Director testimonial. Doubles as vendor intelligence and as a competitor/partner signal in ME payments.

source_name: Cikom d.o.o. Podgorica - systems integrator
why_relevant: Founded 1993, ~70+ specialists, one of ME's leading system integrators for complex ICT solutions and software development. A natural bidder/implementer on bank infrastructure and integration work; site carries history, solutions and partner-vendor pages worth mining for financial-sector references.

source_name: ICT Cortex cluster - Montenegro ICT company member directory
why_relevant: The single best actor-map pointer for this cell: a curated directory of ~37 Montenegrin ICT companies with links, including the finance-relevant ones (Cikom, Logate, PayTen, 2BI, POS4, Financial Solutions, Amplitudo, Codeus, Domen, VG Group, ZZI, Euro Unit). Snowballing this list produces most of the candidate vendor universe for ME.

source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC) - member profiles
why_relevant: MFIC member profile pages carry unusually specific operational detail on foreign-owned vendors in ME - the Payten profile is where the ME-specific figures (28 staff, 6 service centres, 500+ ATMs, 13,000+ POS delivered, 9 of 11 banks) surfaced. A pointer to further foreign vendors active in ME banking/payments.

source_name: Registar firmi Crna Gora (registarfirmi.me) - company profiles
why_relevant: Aggregated ME company register front-end; gives legal name, registration, address and activity code for integrators such as Cikom and Comtrade IT Solutions and Services d.o.o. Podgorica. Used to confirm that a vendor is truly ME-registered (the defining boundary of this cell) and to find sibling entities.

source_name: Comtrade - IT Solutions and Services d.o.o. Podgorica
why_relevant: Comtrade has a ME-registered entity in Podgorica (Serdara Jola Piletica 28, computer programming activity). Comtrade group is a significant regional banking/fintech systems supplier, so the ME entity is a plausible delivery vehicle for bank projects; group case-study pages should be filtered for ME banks.

source_name: poslovni adresar (posao.crna.gora.me) - Montenegro business directory
why_relevant: sr-language ME business directory that surfaced the Comtrade Podgorica entity. Useful for enumerating small ME IT/POS-service firms that have no discoverable website and therefore never appear in English search.

source_name: VG Group / fiskalizacija.me - Adeo POS and fiscal POS software
why_relevant: VG Group operates the fiskalizacija.me service and the Adeo POS fiscal application in ME, with its own call centre (19606). Fiscal POS vendors sit adjacent to card acceptance and are the natural integration counterparties for bank POS/SoftPOS - a competitor/partner layer often missed when only looking at bank-facing vendors.

source_name: eFiskal Crna Gora - electronic fiscalisation provider
why_relevant: ME electronic-fiscalisation software provider; part of the POS software supplier layer that competes for and integrates with merchant payment estates. Client/partner pages indicate merchant reach and any acquirer tie-ins.

source_name: SEKAS - fiscal cash registers and POS systems Montenegro
why_relevant: ME supplier of fiscal cash registers, POS hardware, software and equipment with its own service organisation. Represents the hardware/field-service tier of the ME POS market - the closest local analogue to an ATM/POS service company outside Payten.

source_name: POS4 d.o.o. (ICT Cortex member)
why_relevant: ME company whose name and cluster membership indicate POS software/hardware activity. Not yet characterised - listed as an ICT Cortex member with this domain. Worth a first-pass profile because domestic POS software houses are the integration point between merchants and bank acquirers.

source_name: Smart Tech d.o.o. Podgorica - information systems developer/implementer
why_relevant: ME software house founded 1999, systems in daily use at 80+ companies across ME, RS, BA and AL. Enterprise/financial software candidate; its reference base is a pointer to which ME institutions run domestically built systems.

source_name: Amplitudo d.o.o. Podgorica
why_relevant: One of the larger ME technology companies (software development, digital). Frequent bidder on public and enterprise digital projects; portfolio/case pages should be checked for financial-sector clients and for fintech/e-payment work.

source_name: Bild Studio d.o.o. Podgorica
why_relevant: Long-established ME product development partner (strategy/design/development) and ICT Cortex member; a likely supplier of digital front-ends (mobile/web banking UX) even where the core system is foreign. Its work/portfolio page is the place to test that hypothesis.

source_name: TechBehemoths - IT companies in Podgorica directory
why_relevant: Third-party aggregated directory of ME IT companies with self-declared service lines and client counts. Weak on accuracy but broad on coverage - useful to catch small integrators absent from ICT Cortex and MFIC.

source_name: Erste Bank Montenegro - e-banking platform migration notices (vendor-revealing bank page)
why_relevant: Bank-side customer notices are a reliable indirect confirmation of vendor switches: this page documents Erste ME migrating corporate e-banking from the Halcom platform to Asseco/ASEE eMon OfficeBanking. Bank notice pages date the change, which vendor marketing pages usually do not.

source_name: Halcom - regional e-banking vendor, bank-usage lists and ME support
why_relevant: Halcom's Hal E-Bank has been widely deployed across the region and was in use in ME (Erste ME migrated off it). Halcom publishes per-country 'banks that use Halcom' lists - a direct vendor-to-bank mapping and a churn indicator when a bank drops off.

source_name: CBCG register of financial service providers (payment institutions, factoring, e-money)
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained lists that let you separate real licensed ME payment/fintech actors (e.g. 2BI as a digital payment institution, Financial Solutions d.o.o. Podgorica as a factoring company) from IT firms merely marketing 'fintech'. Essential to qualify vendor candidates and to catch new domestic PSPs entering the market.

source_name: Studio DLD (Budva) - business/accounting software house
why_relevant: ME software house for accounting/SME systems. Relevant to this cell as the integration layer between merchant accounting, fiscalisation and bank payment files (payment order import/export, statement formats) - a low-visibility but real part of the ME payments software chain.

source_name: Payten (Asseco Group) — News & Events newsroom
why_relevant: Payten is the dominant ATM/POS vendor in Montenegro and publishes named customer wins. Confirmed Montenegro item found: SoftPOS (MojPOS) implemented at Hipotekarna banka (published 2022-03-14), developed with Mastercard and Visa. Highest-density vendor-side competitor evidence for the ME payments cell.

source_name: Payten — Montenegro country/market presence page (Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council member profile as corroborating pointer)
why_relevant: Vendor self-description of its Montenegro footprint with quantified installed base: present since 2006, ~28 staff, six service centres, >500 ATMs and >13,000 POS delivered, >350 ATMs and >7,000 POS currently maintained, long-term partnerships with nine of the country's eleven banks. This is directly competitor-sizing evidence.

source_name: ASEE / Asseco South Eastern Europe — News & Events
why_relevant: Confirmed Montenegro core-banking win published by the vendor: Ziraat Bank Montenegro selected ASEE's ASEBA PUB 2000 core banking, implemented in under 3 months, bank live July 2015. ASEE is the main regional core/omnichannel competitor and names its Montenegrin references.
